summary: The global stock selloff worsened in Asia, with Japan’s benchmark dropping the most in more than a year, on concern the US will tighten regulations on the artificial intelligence industry after Democrats’ decisive election win. Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
